basis: empirical pseudo-out-of-sample error dispersion, by within-quarter information stage (jt = n_months_in_quarter); post-COVID target quarters only (>= 2022-01-01). Pre-2020 errors are significantly tighter (F=2.97, p<0.0001) so pooling them would understate current uncertainty.
method: interval = point +/- t(df) * sd, centred on the model's raw output. The measured bias is reported (qoq_bias_pp, bias_t) but NOT applied: RDP 2024-04 does not bias-correct and evaluates on RMSE, which already penalises bias. Stages with fewer than MIN_N observations fall back to `pooled`.
